columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: HITL resume must preserve operator function responses without synthetic-input shadowing
columns.title_zh: HITL 恢复必须保留操作员 Function Response，避免合成输入遮蔽
columns.source_zh: Google ADK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260823-006 with Skill 02 score 46/50. A single-turn workflow resuming after HITL tool confirmation must preserve the operator's FunctionResponse as the authoritative resume input; injecting a duplicate synthetic user event can shadow that evidence and create an indefinite confirmation loop. This is a bounded, high-value Digital Employee continuity and human-authority boundary.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260823-006，Skill 02 评分 46/50。Single-Turn Workflow 在 HITL Tool Confirmation 后恢复时，必须把操作员 FunctionResponse 作为权威恢复输入；重复注入 Synthetic User Event 会遮蔽该证据，并可能造成无限确认循环。该机制形成了一个边界清晰、价值较高的数字员工连续性与人工授权边界。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact resume_inputs path, how FunctionResponse is preserved, why the synthetic event previously shadowed it, which single-turn node types are affected, session-history behavior, and regression coverage. Do not generalize beyond the demonstrated HITL resume path.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 resume_inputs 的精确路径、FunctionResponse 如何保留、旧 Synthetic Event 为何会遮蔽它、受影响的 Single-Turn Node 类型、Session History 行为及回归覆盖；不得泛化到已证明 HITL 恢复路径之外。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Thread provenance classification must survive create, fork and resume without accidental overwrite
columns.title_zh: Thread 来源分类必须贯穿新建、Fork 与 Resume，且不得被意外覆盖
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260823-001 with Skill 02 score 45/50. Callers can explicitly classify newly created and forked threads, the classification is persisted in thread metadata and surfaced through the SDK, while resume preserves the existing source rather than overwriting provenance. This exposes a concrete architecture rule for durable execution-origin metadata across lifecycle transitions.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260823-001，Skill 02 评分 45/50。调用方可显式分类新建与 Fork Thread，该分类进入持久 Thread Metadata 并由 SDK 暴露，而 Resume 会保留既有 Source，不覆盖来源证据。这提供了执行生命周期转换中持久化来源元数据的明确架构规则。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the accepted thread-source values, persistence fields, create/fork/resume write rules, SDK exposure, compatibility behavior, and tests proving resume non-overwrite. Do not infer stronger identity or authorization semantics than source classification provides.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Thread Source 可接受值、持久字段、新建/Fork/Resume 的写入规则、SDK 暴露方式、兼容行为及证明 Resume 不覆盖的测试；不得把来源分类推断为更强的身份或授权语义。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: MCP lifecycle ownership must deduplicate identical server instances before connect and cleanup
columns.title_zh: MCP 生命周期接管前必须按实例去重，避免重复 Connect 与 Cleanup
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260823-004 with Skill 02 score 42/50. MCPServerManager normalizes repeated references to the same server object before lifecycle ownership, ensuring one connect and one cleanup rather than duplicate side effects. The change is narrow but directly testable and maps cleanly to resource-ownership and idempotence requirements in agent infrastructure.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260823-004，Skill 02 评分 42/50。MCPServerManager 在接管生命周期前先规范化指向同一 Server Object 的重复引用，从而保证只执行一次 Connect 与一次 Cleanup，避免重复副作用。该变更范围较窄，但可直接测试，并清晰对应 Agent 基础设施中的资源所有权与幂等性要求。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the uniqueness helper, whether deduplication is identity-based, ordering preservation, connect/cleanup ownership, behavior for distinct equivalent servers, failure propagation, and regression tests. Do not infer distributed exactly-once guarantees from in-process instance deduplication.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验唯一性 Helper、是否按对象身份去重、顺序保持、Connect/Cleanup 所有权、不同但等价 Server 的行为、失败传播及回归测试；不得从进程内实例去重推断分布式 Exactly-Once 保证。
